decisions.reason: The MMAK modular concept has a quantified customer saving of over 600,000 euros a year, so its value is beginning to show, and keeping a concept built from existing machines costs little.
The mobile slow-speed shredder belongs to Doppstadt's core line and has kept its own page across both years, so it is a low-cost option that shows ongoing commitment.
The same MMAK concept now has a named customer reference and quantified savings, which reduces uncertainty in its favour and justifies keeping the option open.
The slow-speed shredder was launched only in 2024, sits in the core product range and has its own page, so its uncertainty has not resolved and dropping it now would be premature.
The spiral shaft screens are a recent launch with little evidence yet, so the option should stay open while results come in, even though the earlier trommel screen was dropped.
